sources.snippet: Overview stable-diffusion-xl-1.-inpainting-.1 is a latent diffusion model developed by diffusers that generates and modifies images based on text prompts with masking-based inpainting capability. The model builds on stable-diffusion-xl-base-1. weights and was trained for 40,000 steps at 1024×1024 resolution with 5% text-conditioning dropout to improve classifier-free guidance. The ...
